title: Reflecting the Male Gaze: Quantifying Female Objectification in 19th and 20th Century Novels

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring female objectification through two metrics: 'agency bias', which uses a semantic role labeler to compare the frequency of male versus female entities acting as grammatical agents, and 'appearance bias', which uses the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) to quantify the semantic association between gendered words and appearance-related terms.
